sources: University of Washington elastic secant model https://faculty.washington.edu/nsniadec/ME354/W08/Lecture33_EcceBuck.pdf

method.first_order: Unreduced Cl. 39.7.1 on slender planes. Orient the smaller end relative to the larger end, keep both physical end rows and check the product of signed component bounds. Reverse curvature checks both signs and the equivalent pairs have no physical station.
method.strength: Independent COL03 strip integration with 32 to 64 angular refinement. Check signed zero-cross-moment capacities, the IS 456 contour, the demand ray and adverse minimum-eccentricity cases one axis at a time.
method.second_order: Constant E=25000 MPa, gross Ix/Iy, 6000 mm, 500 kN, signed end moments (-50,+30) kNm. Exact elastic secant solution, both axes peak at mid-height, no other critical section. An action replay, not a project RC stiffness or global stability reference.
method.optional_reduction: Independent signed prescribed strain state for diagnostic study only. Unreduced additions govern this delivery.
